name: Pasta and Bean Soup
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 large dash of premium olive oil
5 cloves of garlic, peeled and chopped
4 very red tomatoes, chopped finely or one tin (235 g) chopped tomatoes
3 large squeezes of Italian tomato purée
1 sprig of rosemary about 3 inches long
1 large pinch of freshly ground pepper
5 handfuls of pasta shells or penne

steps: Heat the olive oil in the pan, add the chopped garlic and onions, and fry gently for about 3 minutes until translucent but not coloured. Add the cayenne pepper and mix well in the pan.
Add the glass of white wine and allow to evaporate slightly.
Add the water, the stock cubes, the tomato paste, pepper, salt, pasta, and the 2 tins of beans, and allow to simmer gently for as long as the pasta needs to cook (see packet) stirring occasionally.
Once the pasta is al dente, stop the cooking process, add the chopped parsley and the cream, and stir in well.
Add the rosemary sprig, and allow the whole thing to infuse for about 2 hours.

culture.text: Soup is a primarily liquid food, generally served warm or hot – though it is sometimes served chilled – made by cooking or otherwise combining meat or vegetables with stock, milk, or water. According to The Oxford Companion to Food, soup is the main generic term for liquid savoury dishes; others include broth, bisque, consommé, potage and many more.
